LanguageData.RUT_KyberVisitText: Moisture farmers of the {0} have come in on foot, unannounced, and ask to speak with whoever is trading kyber. Two of them carry themselves like farmers who have walked a long way. The third, {1}, carries no weapon, stands very still and says nothing while the others talk. Nobody uses the word "Jedi". Nobody needs to.\n\nThey want a straight answer to one question: how was the kyber obtained? It does not change what they think of you, they say, only whether they can trust what you say next.
LanguageData.RUT_KyberAnswerMined: "We dug it out of the Deeps ourselves."
LanguageData.RUT_KyberVisitEvasive: The Homestead visitors got no answer. They do not argue; suspicion is not a crime, even to them.
LanguageData.RUT_KyberVisitLeft: The Homestead visitors left without an answer about the kyber.
LanguageData.RUT_KyberFixerText: Hutt interest in the clan's kyber has reached {0}. The Cartel now keeps a fixer whose whole business is your crystals: a soft-voiced broker who buys at a fair price and asks nothing.\n\nNearly nothing. Along with the price list comes a message he swears he only carries: someone working the same smuggling lanes would like a word about kyber that is given, not sold.
